properties.name: Koraput District
properties.physiography: Eastern Ghats crystalline mobile belt, elevated plateau dissected by seasonal river valleys.
properties.hydrogeology: Hard-rock charnockites and khondalites; groundwater in weathered residuum and fracture systems; extensive perched mountain springs.

properties.name: Mandla and Dindori Districts
properties.physiography: Central Indian tribal plateau, Upper Narmada basin and Satpura-Maikal range.
properties.hydrogeology: Deccan Trap vesicular and amygdaloidal basalts with inter-trappean beds; high summer radiometric heat anomalies; rapid runoff on trap scarps.

properties.name: Khunti and West Singhbhum Districts
properties.physiography: Chota Nagpur granite-gneiss plateau and Kolhan basin, undulating upland ridges (tanr) and low-gradient valleys (don).
properties.hydrogeology: Archaean granite-gneiss complex and Singhbhum shear zone rocks; fracture permeability in weathered crystalline basement; acute pre-monsoon water depletion.

properties.name: Pan-India Extensible Framework
properties.physiography: Covers all hydro-climatic zones across Peninsular India hard rocks, Indo-Gangetic alluvium, and Himalayan watersheds.
properties.hydrogeology: Dynamic nationwide multi-criteria model ingestion using SRTM 30m, CHIRPS climatology, SoilGrids, and CGWB monitoring networks.
